scope: New post-result analyses only; existing deviation files and frozen plan remain unchanged
reporting_rule: Report all results regardless of direction; do not replace any prespecified analysis; register D005-D007 in the manuscript

deviations.name: Same-loss empirical naive-M comparator
deviations.definition: Use the same weed-positive-image miss loss, original calibration/test draws and full-spray fallback as main CRC; omit only the finite-sample correction

deviations.name: Nested group order with fixed K100-pool-complement test set
deviations.superseded_definition: Reuse the original K100 test set for the original K-specific calibration samples
deviations.superseded_definition_problem: Formal sampling seeds depend on K; smaller-K calibration pools can overlap the K100 test set
deviations.approved_definition: One new shuffle per repeat with a K-independent D006 seed; prefix calibration pools and K-specific samples; all K share the complement of the K100 calibration pool

deviations.name: Monte Carlo standard errors and 10-percent boundary flags
deviations.definition: Main CRC n=4, grouped K=20/50 and ideal K=50; each training seed separately; sample SD over 200 draw-level M values divided by sqrt(200); flag absolute mean-minus-0.1 no greater than 2SE
deviations.scope_of_uncertainty: Conditional Monte Carlo uncertainty only, not variation across training seeds or a guarantee
